methodology.asOf: Historical gate factors are locked at the T-2 close, the decision is published before the T-1 open, and the stock purchase remains at the T-1 close.
methodology.safetyCoverage: Trailing median Strategy B bond gain from the latest 60 Shenzhen bonds already exited before T-2, divided by estimated stock cash at the T-2 close.
methodology.conversionValue: 100 × unadjusted stock T-2 close ÷ initial conversion price.
methodology.issueConversionPremium: Issue price ÷ T-2 conversion value − 1. This is a pre-listing issue-price proxy, not a tradable market premium.
methodology.marketAverageBondPrice: Arithmetic mean of unadjusted T-2 closes for all observable listed public convertible bonds in Shanghai and Shenzhen; the companion median and cross-sectional bond count are published per event. Factor bins use full-sample quartiles and are descriptive, not trading thresholds.
methodology.themeProxy: Stock five-session return minus the matching Shenzhen board-index five-session return; currentThemes are descriptive only and excluded from scoring to prevent look-ahead.
methodology.supportScore: One point each for conversion value 100–110, issue scale at least CNY 1bn, CSI 300 five-session return non-negative, and trailing safety coverage at least 2%.
methodology.caveat: Univariate historical grouping, not a causal model or investment recommendation.
